notes: Second pass: retire now means empty, or nothing but a filter. A gallery set that matches a book collection merges into it, and anything else is kept as a collection.
Reached 351 public book collection records of about 393, and 266 of 266 gallery sets.

41 further records came back from /api/collections with visible:false. Their pages return 404 or 410, and the code says hidden records include takedowns, so they are left out of records and not listed here, apart from SHWEP below. That leaves about 1 of the 393 unaccounted for.
SHWEP Reading Room is one of those hidden records (its page returns 404 and it has visible:false), so it is not classified here, although the plan calls it a Collection.
The unauthenticated flags ?unpublished=true and ?includeHidden=true were not used. Unpublished curated records and hidden gallery sets could not be seen, so hidden gallery sets are not counted.
14 records have hidden:true but visible not false. Their pages load, so they are included.

Most fields come from /api/collections?includeChildren=true&limit=1000, which returns the same stored record as /api/collections/<slug>. That endpoint skips visual_art records, so those came from /api/collections/<slug>?limit=1, found through /collections/all and sitemap/1.xml.
The site returned 429 with Retry-After 60 during fetching. Fetching slowed to one request every 8 seconds.

8 public gallery sets point at hidden book collections. One is collection-kloss-collection: its gallery page returns 200 while the Kloss book collection page returns 410, so its 4 images deserve a check against the takedown.

9 book_collection_slug values on gallery sets return 404: chinese-medicine, ficinos-circle, herbals-botany, jyotisha-indian-astrology, music-harmony, natural-magic-sub, paracelsian-iatrochemistry, theosophical-occult, zoroastrianism.

looks_handmade for the 250 thematic sets rests on template text and copied slugs. Their image lists were not read. For the 16 visual sets it rests on src/app/api/admin/seed-collections/route.ts, which builds all 16 by rule, so later hand edits cannot be ruled out.

books and artworks are the stored book_count and artwork_count. Null means the record has no value. proposed_subject is null for Subjects and library slices. For gallery sets, parent holds book_collection_slug and kind holds the gallery type.
